files.notes: Creates identities with a cascading user reference and a Go namespace template.
Copies existing user email identities with INSERT SELECT inside a templated DO block; no row data is embedded.
Changes two phone columns to text inside a DO block with SQLSTATE-specific handlers and a Go namespace template.
Adds a non-null anonymous-user flag with a false default inside a templated DO block.
Adds a phone factor enum value, then adds columns and a unique index; includes Go namespace templates.
Adds and validates a NOT VALID foreign key, then indexes the new session column; includes Go namespace templates.
Renames the boolean lock column, derives timestamp lock values, and drops the old column.
Replaces two event-log indexes with a partial index for fetching pending events.
Adds a cleanup table with check and unique constraints and drops a foreign key from invocation logs.
Replaces a PL/pgSQL event writer with branching for server versions before and after 9.6.
Sets REPLICA IDENTITY FULL; the upstream comment cites 15.15 as an example, not a minimum.
Initializes authorization tables and partial indexes; Goose Down drops the tables.
Adds a required model schema version with a constant default; Goose Down drops the column.
Creates and reverses an index for reverse tuple lookups.
Adds a nullable BYTEA column; Goose Down drops it.
Adds and reverses multiple columns per table in two tables.
Goose NO TRANSACTION covers both directions of the concurrent collation-index swap.
Makes a foreign key deferrable; the two-transaction example is in a comment, not executed SQL.
Replaces the helper that propagates replica identity from parent to child tables; retains the extension schema placeholder.
Replaces partition-routing functions, including dynamic CTEs to move rows into child partitions; retains the extension schema placeholder.
Replaces the archive conversion helper, which renames the old table and builds a range-partitioned replacement via dynamic SQL.
Replaces queue creation functions containing dynamic DDL for regular, unlogged and partitioned queues.
Creates the migration ledger with a unique version index and River schema markers.
Initializes the job state enum, checks, GIN and partial indexes, and a trigger; retains River schema markers.
Sets a default, backfills null tags, and enforces NOT NULL.
Backfills job JSON columns before enforcing NOT NULL, adds a job enum value and replaces a check.
Conditionally recreates the migration ledger and copies its rows before dropping the old table, then adds client tables.
Uses a bitmask expression for a partial unique index and removes its predecessor.
Adds the notification outbox, removes obsolete client tables, and changes existing column defaults.
Drops the owner foreign key from objects.
Switches the objects ID default to gen_random_uuid().
Adds multipart tables and references, an expression index, row-level security, and dynamic SQL.
Widens two multipart size columns to bigint.
Defines a prefix backfill using CTE batches and COMMIT in a DO block; the pinned runner skips the file via its ignore directive.
Defines an object-level backfill using writable CTEs and COMMIT in a DO block; the pinned runner skips the file via its ignore directive.
Defines a concurrent unique index; the pinned runner skips the file via its ignore directive.
Conditionally adds VECTOR to an existing enum inside a DO block.
Drops an index concurrently with a disable-transaction directive.
Adds lifecycle configuration columns and three NOT VALID checks guarded by catalog queries.
Validates the three lifecycle checks in a separate migration.
Widens the RPC address column.
Adds required previous transaction IDs to history nodes with a zero default.
Widens IDs on two workflow persistence tables.
Drops the unused tiered storage task table.
Drops and re-adds the data encoding column as a required VARCHAR with an empty default.
Rebuilds two visibility columns and their expression indexes.
Adds generated visibility columns and concurrent expression indexes; drops invalid predecessor indexes.
Replaces an enum and casts its dependent column within explicit BEGIN and COMMIT.
Backfills a temporary BIGINT column from a timestamp, swaps columns, and commits.
Recreates an enum across scalar and array columns in one explicit transaction.
Adds a project alert enum value and a cascading task-run foreign key.
Creates a range-partitioned task events table with a composite primary key and indexes.
Removes five foreign keys from the execution snapshot table.
Adds webhook endpoints and a range-partitioned delivery table with parent indexes.
Renames event-data columns and adds report and session-data tables, indexes, and foreign keys.
Adds a series of analytics indexes across event, session, and session-data tables.
Copies existing website owners to created_by and removes the team join table.
Changes text widths, adds links and pixels, and rewrites and copies existing report configuration.
Drops a series of duplicate unique indexes.
Deduplicates session-data rows with a windowed CTE before creating a unique index.
